descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S30 Ask on Post-Round, Nursing Home: 'Summarize the encounter' for a long-term resident uses only what is stored

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T10 Ask from Post-Round (TFA-92593): 'Ask About the Encounter or Patient' opens from Post-Round in both contexts, and its answers use only this patient's stored data: the saved note as last edited, nothi … (TFA-92593 AC 2; TFA-92593 AC 3; TFA-92593 AC 6; TFA-92593 AC 9; UAT 3.4; UAT TC-17)
  • U14 AI check on scenarios, not single passes (3.2), if it applies to Post-Round Ask (Q8): the Ask set runs on at least 10 independent fixtures (5 Hospital, 5 Nursing Home), passes at 9/10 or better, and … (UAT 3.2)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Nursing Home long-term-care resident with an encounter note and a generated note, no medication changes

When Ask the Post-Round preset 'Summarize the encounter'

Then The summary covers sleep, meals and the family update, and nothing that is not stored

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): mustInclude stored facts; mustNotInclude drugs and events a model may supply for dementia in long-term care, and the 3.4 phrases. Runs the Hospital context builder until RG-NH is closed, so it counts for grounding, not for the Nursing Home code path. aiCheck group TC-17-ask

Where it ran: dev unit U54; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S30 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
